## Recall: factorise fully

Close your notes. Factorise both expressions before selecting Next.

**A.** $3x^2-10x+8$ &emsp; **B.** $8x^2+4x-12$

::: {.fragment}

**A.** $P=24$, $S=-10$. The pairs $(-1,-24),(-2,-12),(-3,-8),(-4,-6)$ sum to $-25,-14,-11,-10$. Choose $-4,-6$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

$3x^2-6x-4x+8=3x(x-2)-4(x-2)=(3x-4)(x-2)$

:::

::: {.fragment}

**B.** Take out 4: $4(2x^2+x-3)$. For $P=-6$, $S=1$, choose $-2,3$ from $(-1,6),(-2,3)$; the sums are $5,1$.

:::

::: {.fragment}

$4(2x^2-2x+3x-3)=4[2x(x-1)+3(x-1)]=4(2x+3)(x-1)$

:::
